response.original_title: {FAQ™~Room~Step} How Can I Add Another Room or cabin to My Celebrity Cruise ?
response.overview: To add an extra passenger to an existing reservation, you must call Celebrity Cruises Customer Service directly at +1888⇢315⇢9585 or contact your original travel advisor, as this cannot be done online. To add an entirely separate room to an existing Celebrity Cruise booking, you cannot do it online; instead, you must book a separate new stateroom and have it linked by calling Celebrity Cruises customer service at +1888⇢315⇢9585 (US) or +1888⇢315⇢9585 (UK), or by contacting your travel advisor To add an passenger to an existing reservation, you must call Celebrity Cruises Customer
